# S607 — add a test that every name in renderFixtureNames appears in the UI brief's fixture list

**Findings:**  · **Size:**  · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The UI pass brief tells the UI role which `-render-fixture` names it can ask for (`internal/engine/brief.go:233`). That list is typed by hand and has drifted from `renderFixtureNames` (`internal/cli/render_test.go:428`). The matrix-copy fixtures `matrix-copy-preview`, `matrix-copy-ask` and `matrix-copy-stale-preview` are in `renderFixtureNames` and in `renderViews`, but the brief does not name them. A UI pass reading only its brief cannot know it can render them.

No test ties the two lists together, so this drift went unnoticed. This slice adds a test in the CLI package, which already imports `engine`, that builds the UI brief and requires every name in `renderFixtureNames` to be in its fixture list. It also adds the three missing names to the brief so the test passes. The test compares exact names, not substrings, because `wave-start` is a substring of `wave-start-finding` and `projects-set` of `projects-set-refusals`.

## Files

- `internal/cli/render_test.go:426-428` (new test beside `renderFixtureNames`)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:233` (add the three names to the fixture sentence)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1084-1097` (the `TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures` expected sentence)

## Failing tests

- TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture (new, in `internal/cli/render_test.go`): it builds the UI brief with `engine.BuildBrief`, using Role `engine.RoleUI` and the minimum inputs (SliceID, Worktree, TempDir, ReportPath, SliceJSON). It cuts out the fixture list: the text after `The names are the five above (without .txt) and ` up to the next `. Copy the views`. It fails if that sentence is missing, so a reworded brief cannot make the check pass silently. It splits the list on `, ` and a final ` and ` into exact names. For each name in `renderFixtureNames` it asserts the name is in that set. It is red now, with one error each for `matrix-copy-preview`, `matrix-copy-ask` and `matrix-copy-stale-preview`.
- TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures (existing, `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1086`): it asserts the exact fixture sentence in the brief. Its expected string changes with the brief text, so it is red until both edits are made.

## Implement

1. In `internal/cli/render_test.go`, write `TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture` as described under Failing tests. Use `strings.Cut` for the sentence and `strings.Split` plus a trim of the leading `and ` for the names. Run it and see it fail on the three matrix-copy names.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go:233`, change the fixture sentence. Keep `wave-start-finding` last, after ` and `, and add the three names before it: `... projects-setup, fake-reply, matrix-copy-preview, matrix-copy-ask, matrix-copy-stale-preview and wave-start-finding.` Change nothing else in the line.
3. In `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1097`, update the expected substring to the new list. In the comment at line 1085, change "the eight fixtures it adds" to match the list.
4. Run the new test and `TestUIPassBriefNamesRenderFixtures` and see both pass. Run `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .`.
5. Write the slice's changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S607 --text "..."`, as AGENTS.md says. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
